title: audit-<walker>.json
description: One auditor's judgement of one walker's checks-<walker>.json, row by row, from the images alone. Written by certifier-auditor. The orchestrator may complete a row after opening an orphan image, and says so in completedBy.

walker.description: Same id as the checks file audited.

summary.description: Counts per support value, then the whole-file checks: missing images, orphan images by name, commit drift, captions or strips the page contradicts, and anything visible in an image that nobody reported.

id.description: The check or defect id, exactly as in checks-<walker>.json.

support.description: SUPPORTED: the verdict follows from what is visible in the cited images. PARTIAL: part of the claim is visible, part lives only in the strip, the note or below the fold. UNSUPPORTED: the images do not show what the verdict needs, or the row can only be decided by walking (the reason says what a walk would have to look at).

reason.description: Required unless SUPPORTED. One or two sentences naming the image and what is or is not on it.

completedBy.description: Omitted means auditor. orchestrator: the gap was closed by citing an image already on disk, after opening it.
